選多個場景表示同一輸入共用模型。模型卡並存代表都需要運行；比較替代方案時請先移除: Scenes share one input and all selected models run concurrently. Remove a model to compare alternatives.
先排除框架、容量及路徑不合的配置，再比較可查證部署方向。數值是規劃優先權，不是性: Exclude incompatible runtime, memory and deployment routes first, then compare documented paths. Scores indicate planning priority, not performance or probability.
硬性限制先排除；依所選技術或採購優先排序，同分以採購等級，再以資料順序處理。未知: Hard exclusions come first, then the selected technical/procurement order. Procurement band and stable list order break ties. Unknown power and latency remain unverified.
若相機未拍到足夠紋理，提高算力無法補回資訊。若推論頻率不足，先確認 causal: Compute cannot recover uncaptured texture. For insufficient update rates, check causal/window variant, points and input size before comparing platforms.
此組合無額外加權；仍可進行工程評估。: No additional priority weight for this combination; engineering evaluation remains possible.
靜態／動態決定觀測方式；即時／非即時決定時間期限。兩個維度分開判斷。: Static/dynamic determines acquisition; live/batch determines timing. Evaluate both dimensions independently.
相機是否看得清楚？: Can the camera observe sufficient detail?
特徵像素、曝光、幀間位移；不行先改光學。: Feature pixels, exposure and inter-frame motion; improve optics first if needed.

FPS；未含追蹤、VLM、深度、搬移與利用率，不等於硬體 TOPS 下限。: FPS; excludes tracking, VLM, depth, transfer and utilization. Not a minimum hardware TOPS requirement.
此模型組合尚無足夠資料估算硬體容量，請先取得真機 profile。: Insufficient workload evidence for hardware sizing. Profile on hardware first.

官方系列電源模式 7–25 W；不是整機功耗。8 GB 的模型與時序記憶體仍需量: Official module power modes 7–25W, not system power. Profile model and temporal-state memory in 8GB.
適合先驗證多模型與客製算子路徑；仍需指定 JetPack、TensorRT、散熱: Prototype multiple models/custom operators; pin JetPack, TensorRT, thermal design and power mode.
64 GB 是本候選的規劃配置，產品族非固定 SKU。方便整合 x86 與多種: 64GB is a planning configuration, not a fixed product-family SKU. Verify exact system RAM, NPU compatibility and power.
適合從相機整合與固定工作負載評估；板級 I/O、RAM、QNN 版本及 op p: Evaluate camera integration and fixed workloads; verify board I/O, RAM, QNN version and operator partition.
先編譯固定形狀偵測模型；官方 op 表的 GridSample、NMS 限制須檢: Compile a fixed-shape detector first. Check GridSample/NMS limitations and evaluate host NMS separately.
64 GB 統一記憶體；大型模型須計入權重、狀態、ASR/TTS、OS 與 co: 64GB unified memory. Include weights, state, ASR/TTS, OS and context. No verified Strata ARM/Jetson route in this tool.
128 GB 統一記憶體，官方模組模式 40–130 W；容量充足仍要驗證模型: 128GB unified memory, documented module modes 40–130W. Verify model kernels, JetPack and first-audio deadline despite ample capacity.
依 Strata 專案的實際測試配置建立候選；桌機型 edge box，功耗與尺: Candidate based on the Strata project's desktop test configuration. Power/size differ from embedded modules. RAM upgrades need a separate configuration.
使用者提供的 Strata 討論與專案實驗支援路徑；128 GB 是本候選的配置: Experimental Strata route from user-provided discussion/project docs. 128GB is a configuration assumption; confirm iGPU allocation, system and runtime commit.
面向整合影像處理與安防相機；板卡 RAM、SDK access、可匯入網路與第三: Integrated imaging/security-camera route. Confirm board RAM, SDK access, importable networks and third-party operators with the supplier.
本候選是官方提供的 16GB LPDDR5x / 128GB UFS 配置；最高: Documented 16GB LPDDR5x/128GB UFS configuration. Up to five concurrent cameras is a SoM specification; verify carrier, resolution, FPS and drivers. 48 INT8 TOPS does not prove workload real time.
未發現輸入衝突；算子與效能仍待實測: No known input conflicts; operators and performance still need measurement
無已知輸入衝突；不代表已驗證可行。: No known input conflicts; feasibility remains unverified.
本工具使用規則推導；未執行真機 benchmark。多場景假設同一輸入共享模型，: Rule-based planning; no hardware benchmark performed. Scenes share one input; evaluate separate pipelines independently.
確認目標在畫面中是否足夠清楚；只有追蹤或移動取像才需要運動細節。: Check that the target is visible enough. Motion details apply to tracking or moving cameras.
相對深度只比較前後關係；選擇測距或避障後，再填公尺誤差與有效距離。: Relative depth compares near and far. Choose measurement or avoidance to specify metric error and usable distance.
僅顯示目前應用需要的條件；進階設定可按需展開。切換場景後，不適用的舊值不參與評估: Only applicable conditions are shown. Expand advanced settings when needed; inactive values from other scenarios do not affect the assessment.
